question: Does A19 get stronger on the Cemetery map when a native strike on a standing NEUTRAL barrel (melee or ranged) is compared with legal move/wait/defend/spell alternatives by the existing bounded search instead of being returned without comparison?

candidateDefinition.rule: At an actual A19 root of the named entrant whose native incumbent contains an obstacle strike on a standing scattered stone that is not a deployment barrel, the strike enters the same deliberation the adopted v9 switch gives melee deployment-barrel strikes: no cemetery fast return, wait and defend challengers admitted, no forced-productive tier, unchanged H64/R2/K6, value gate, scored/material arbitration and neural tie correction. The strike stays candidate zero.
unchanged: native v0.8 cleanup at roots and inside every forecast
deployment-barrel handling (melee deliberation on, ranged fast return)
draft, setup, splits, placement, models and search budgets
candidateDefinition.scope: entrant seat only; the opponent runs the unmodified default stack

source.runnerNote: run-shard2.ts preserves a rejected game in <out>.rejected.jsonl and finishes the shard; any rejection fails the quality gate

population.drafts: actual V3/contextual/exclusive-delivery native drafts, all nine own x opponent doctrine pairings, balanced pick order, both physical seats, no eligibility filter (scan order)
population.selection: reserve families with scan index 120..419 in each of the nine doctrine cells; fixed before any game on them

unopenedRemainder.use: not part of this registration; stays reserved

primaryEndpoint: mean paired match-score difference candidate minus current (win 1, draw 0.5, loss 0); the unit is one draft family (both seats); 20,000 whole-family bootstrap resamples, mulberry32 seed 2026111902, index floor(u32*n/2^32), percentile 2.5/97.5

gates.quality: all 10,800 results present, duplicate rows identical, independent input hashes and journal winners verified, zero quality errors, source manifest verified on every host before and after
gates.independentReconstruction: analysis/final_analysis.py and analysis/final_analysis.ts must agree on every half-point total and on the sha256 of all bootstrap sums
gates.inertness: every off-map control pair (inert-bank.json, 80 Normal/Lava cases incl. all exposed Barrel Barricade cases) has identical digests under current and candidate, rerun under this manifest
gates.nativeParity: the capsule current arm reproduces the unpatched server digest on the 48 fixed development cases, rerun under this manifest
gates.cost: separate serial AB/BA study on 72 fixed development cases: complete adapter CPU and CPU per authoritative decision each within +10% overall
gates.coldReplay: after collection, shards 0 and 47 (about 225 games each) are recomputed in fresh processes on a different host; every digest, score and decision count must be identical

rules: no interim aggregate inspection of confirmation scores
no retry with another seed, no extension, no subset rescue
a shard may be recomputed on another host; duplicates must be identical and are counted once

a shard process that dies from a runtime crash (observed once before registration: a Bun abort in a control shard that did not recur on restart) is restarted and resumes after its last completed row, at most 8 times; crash logs are preserved; a completed or rejected game is never replayed with different inputs

exposedRecon.bank: 72 exposed Cemetery families from the Sniper study

developmentHistoryAtRegistration.note: Development selected this single candidate. Other arms are separate hypotheses; none shares this confirmation bank.

promotion: none automatic; a pass is evidence for an explicit user adoption decision
